scheme_name: Integrated Social Security Scheme - Women In Distress
other_conditions: Applicant must be a destitute widow, divorced, or deserted woman
Applicant must have an annual income less than ₹75,000 or belong to the Below Poverty Line (BPL) category
benefits_summary: A monthly pension of ₹1,000 is deposited directly into the beneficiary's bank account.
